takeaway: The radial nerve runs in the spiral groove of the humerus, so a humeral shaft fracture can injure it and cause wrist drop.

lines.text: A 38-year-old woman falls from her horse at low speed.
lines.say: A thirty-eight-year-old woman falls from her horse at low speed.

lines.text: She suffers a twisting injury, and feels pain in the region of the fracture.
Radiographs show a fracture of the humeral diaphysis, the shaft of the humerus.
On the same side, she has a wrist drop.
The radial nerve runs in the spiral groove of the humerus.
So it is vulnerable when the humeral shaft breaks.
Radial nerve injury causes her wrist drop.
